title: Zoning text change for open space in South Richmond, Staten Island
summary: The City Planning Commission's decision would adjust Designated Open Space boundaries within the Special South Richmond Development District in the Prince's Bay and Arden Heights neighborhoods of Staten Island. The amendment also updates outdated and contradictory zoning text to align with the 2023 South Richmond Zoning Relief changes. A city review found the change would not create new environmental impacts beyond those already studied in 2023.
